apps.code.aborted: Orglane's check of the new version failed, so the previous version was restored.
apps.code.accountNotFound: The linked account no longer exists in the app. The person links their current account, then Orglane retries.
apps.code.accountRefused: The app refused this person's account details, for example an email address another account uses. Fix them, then retry.
apps.code.agentInstanceMissing: The agent does not know this app yet. Orglane sends it again.
apps.code.agentStalled: The agent did not start this operation within an hour, so Orglane stopped waiting. Check the agent, then try again.
apps.code.agentUnavailable: Waiting for the agent that runs this app. Orglane keeps trying; check that the agent is running.
apps.code.agentUnhealthy: A service of this app is not running or not healthy. The agent keeps it running; check its logs if this stays.
apps.code.agentUntrusted: The agent's answers are not signed with the shared secret. Check that Orglane and the agent use the same ORGLANE_AGENT_SECRET.
apps.code.agentVersionMismatch: The agent runs another version of Orglane, so Orglane sends it no changes. Update Orglane and the agent together (docker compose pull, then up -d).
apps.code.composeFailed: The agent could not start the app's services. Check the agent's logs.
apps.code.confirmTimeout: The new version was not confirmed in time, so the previous version was restored.
apps.code.credentialMissing: A credential this change was recorded with no longer exists. Make the change again.
apps.code.databaseFailed: The agent could not prepare the app's database. Check the agent's logs.
apps.code.dnsLookupFailed: The DNS lookup failed. Try again in a moment.
apps.code.dnsMismatch: This address points to another server. Point it to the same address as the workspace, then try again.
apps.code.dnsUnresolved: This address does not exist in DNS yet. Add a record that points to this server, then try again.
apps.code.forgejoRejected: Forgejo refused the change. Check the details, then retry.
apps.code.forgejoUnavailable: Forgejo did not answer. Orglane retries automatically.
apps.code.generationConflict: The address settings changed while this ran. Orglane sends the change again.
apps.code.githubForbidden: GitHub does not allow the App to make this change (for example, a team synced from an identity provider). Change it on GitHub, then retry.
apps.code.githubRejected: GitHub refused the change. Check the details, then retry.
apps.code.githubUnauthorized: GitHub refused the App's access. Orglane retries; if this stays, check that the App is still installed on the organization.
apps.code.githubUnavailable: GitHub did not answer. Orglane retries automatically.
apps.code.healthCheckFailed: The app runs but does not answer as expected. Orglane keeps checking it.
apps.code.healthTimeout: The app's services did not become healthy in time. Check the agent's logs.
apps.code.hookFailed: Configuring the app's services failed. Check the agent's logs.
apps.code.hostNotLocal: On this local installation, the address must end in .localhost.
apps.code.hostTaken: Another app uses this address. Choose another one.

apps.code.installationSuspended: The GitHub App's installation is suspended. Unsuspend it in the organization's settings; this clears when GitHub reports it.
apps.code.installFailed: Installing this app failed; the operations below say why. Once the cause is fixed, remove the app and reinstall it, or delete it permanently and install it again.
apps.code.insufficientDisk: This server does not have enough free disk space for this app.
apps.code.insufficientMemory: This server does not have enough memory for this app next to the ones already installed.

apps.code.invalidLogin: The app refused this person's username. Change the username, then retry.
apps.code.inviteRefused: The app refused to invite this person (for example, the account blocks the organization). Resolve it in the app, then retry.
apps.code.keyReserved: Another app uses this key, or a removed app's data still holds it. Choose another key, or delete that app's data.

apps.code.loginChanged: The account's username changed while Orglane worked. Orglane retries automatically.
apps.code.maintainerProtected: This person maintains the team in the app, so Orglane never removes them from it. Change their team role in the app if they should go.
apps.code.noAccount: The account is not there yet. Orglane retries automatically.
apps.code.notInvited: The person is not invited to the app's organization yet. Orglane invites them and retries automatically.
apps.code.ownerProtected: Owners of the app's organization are never removed by Orglane.
apps.code.ownershipUnproven: This person's account already exists in the app, but Orglane cannot prove it created it, so it is not managed and never removed automatically. Review it, then use Retry failed to accept it as unmanaged.
apps.code.packageUnavailable: This version of the app is not part of this Orglane build. Update Orglane.
apps.code.policyViolation: The agent refused the app's configuration because it breaks a safety rule.
apps.code.providerError: The app did not answer as expected. Orglane retries automatically.
apps.code.providerUnavailable: This version of Orglane cannot talk to this app.
apps.code.pullFailed: The agent could not download the app's images. Check the server's internet access.
apps.code.purgeFailed: Deleting this app's data failed. Check the agent's logs, then delete it permanently again.
apps.code.rateLimited: The app asked Orglane to slow down. It retries once the app allows it.
apps.code.removeFailed: Removing this app failed. Check the agent's logs, then remove it again.
apps.code.roleProtected: This person has a special role in the app's organization (for example billing manager), so Orglane never removes them. Change the role in the app if they should go.
apps.code.rollbackFailed: The new version failed and the previous version could not be restored. Restore the app's snapshot to recover it.
apps.code.seatLimit: The app has no free seats. Add seats in the app, then retry.
apps.code.serviceAdminInvalid: Orglane cannot sign in to the app as its administrator. Orglane retries; if this stays, check the app's service account.
apps.code.setupFailed: Setting up this app failed. Check the service, then retry the setup.
apps.code.ssoNotConfigured: Sign-in with Orglane is not set up in the app yet. Orglane retries; if this stays, reinstall the app.
apps.code.superseded: Replaced by a newer change before it ran.
apps.code.teamNotManaged: A team this person is mapped to is not managed by Orglane (its description lost the Managed by Orglane mark), so Orglane does not change it. Restore that mark in the team's description to keep the team, or rename the team in the app so Orglane creates its own, then retry.
apps.code.teamNotSynced: A team this person is mapped to does not exist in the app yet. Orglane creates it and retries automatically.
apps.code.upgradeFailed: The upgrade failed and the app's previous version is unknown. Check the agent's logs and the operation history.
apps.code.upgradePathBlocked: This Orglane release has no upgrade path for the app yet.
apps.code.usernameTaken: Another account in the app already has this person's username, and Orglane never takes over an account it did not create. Rename or remove that account in the app, then retry.
apps.code.webhookDeleted: The app no longer sends events to Orglane: its webhook was deleted. Set the webhook URL and secret again in the app (for GitHub, in the App's settings); the next event it delivers clears this.
